context: Daichi and Tatsuya prepare for the summer harvest.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: たつや、夏野菜、もうすぐ、収穫やな。
lines.en: Tatsuya — the summer vegetables will be ready to harvest soon.
lines.style: Kansai lilt running through bright, warm opening. Leans in with genuine anticipation. Soft at the edges, threading warmth throughout without forcing it.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: うん、今年も、立派、出来た。
lines.en: Yeah — we did well this year too. Really turned out beautifully.
lines.style: Slow, unhurried. Low warm tone. Pride sits quietly underneath. Country composure, gentle and genuine. No rush in the words.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 皆で、頑張った結果、本当。
lines.en: It's because we all put in the work together. Really.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with philosophical turn. Slight emphasis on the shared effort. Sincere appreciation threaded through. Bright but grounded.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 家族、皆、来てくれる、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm so happy the whole family came out.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude underneath. Slow delivery, each word given space. Tender without sentimentality. Rural composure. Genuine warmth in the trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Being together like this — this summer has been good.
lines.style: Kansai swing bright and sincere. Philosophical weight underneath. Tender close. Soft real warmth woven throughout, unforced.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: I'm truly grateful — to all of you.
lines.style: Deep gratitude. Slow, measured. Low warm tone. Words given weight and space. Country composure. Gentle but carrying real emotion underneath.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Let's give it our all again next year.
lines.style: Kansai brightness on the opening. Warm promise in the closing. Tender but with resolve underneath. Soft real warmth, looking forward.
